```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center"
)

library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(gtsummary)
library(scales)

theme_gtsummary_compact()
theme_gtsummary_journal(journal = "jama")

#Settings Needed to Recreate Tables/Figures


nsim <- 2500

n_values <- c(250, 500)
rho_values <- c(0, 0.35, 0.70)

p <- 20
p_nonzero <- 5

v_names <- paste0("V", sprintf("%02d", 1:p))

true_betas <- c(0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5) / 3
beta_true <- c(true_betas, rep(0, p - p_nonzero))

nfolds_glmnet <- 5
run_label <- paste0("nsim_", nsim, "_cv", nfolds_glmnet)

output_path <- "C:/Users/kokeshem/Spring 2026/Advanced Statistical Methods/Project 4/Project 4 output"

final_rdata <- file.path(
  output_path,
  paste0("Project4_Final_Results_", run_label, ".RData")
)

if (!file.exists(final_rdata)) {
  stop("Could not find final RData file: ", final_rdata)
}

load(final_rdata)

dim(full_simulation_results)
names(full_simulation_results)
```

```{r}
#Labels and Analysis Dataset


method_order <- c(
  "Back_05", "AIC", "BIC",
  "Lasso_min", "Lasso_1se",
  "ENet_min",  "ENet_1se"
)

method_labels <- c(
  "Back_05"   = "Backward p < 0.05",
  "AIC"       = "Backward AIC",
  "BIC"       = "Backward BIC",
  "Lasso_min" = "Lasso lambda.min",
  "Lasso_1se" = "Lasso lambda.1se",
  "ENet_min"  = "Elastic net lambda.min",
  "ENet_1se"  = "Elastic net lambda.1se"
)

true_betas_map <- tibble(
  var = v_names,
  true_beta = beta_true,
  is_true = beta_true != 0,
  variable_type = if_else(beta_true != 0, "True predictor", "Null predictor")
)

analysis_data <- full_simulation_results %>%
  left_join(true_betas_map, by = "var") %>%
  mutate(
    method = factor(method, levels = method_order),
    method_label = recode(as.character(method), !!!method_labels),
    method_label = factor(method_label, levels = method_labels[method_order]),

    estimate_unconditional = if_else(selected == 1, estimate, 0),

    bias_unconditional = estimate_unconditional - true_beta,
    sq_error_unconditional = bias_unconditional^2,

    bias_selected = estimate - true_beta,

    covered_unconditional = case_when(
      selected == 1 ~ covered_selected,
      selected == 0 & is_true ~ 0,
      selected == 0 & !is_true ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    scenario_label = paste0("N = ", N, ", rho = ", Rho)
  )

# Sanity checks
stopifnot(
  nrow(full_simulation_results) == nsim * length(n_values) *
    length(rho_values) * length(method_order) * p
)

rows_per_cell <- full_simulation_results %>%
  count(N, Rho, method, iteration_id) %>%
  pull(n)

stopifnot(all(rows_per_cell == p))

stopifnot(
  full_simulation_results %>%
    filter(selected == 1, is.na(estimate)) %>%
    nrow() == 0
)

iteration_level_summary <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(method, method_label, N, Rho, scenario_label, iteration_id) %>%
  summarise(
    model_size = sum(selected),
    true_positives = sum(selected[is_true]),
    false_positives = sum(selected[!is_true]),
    any_false_positive = as.numeric(false_positives > 0),
    any_null_significant = as.numeric(any(significant[!is_true] == 1)),
    perfect_model_recovery = as.numeric(
      true_positives == p_nonzero & false_positives == 0
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
table1_data <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(method, method_label, N, Rho, scenario_label) %>%
  summarise(
    tpr = mean(selected[is_true]),
    fpr = mean(selected[!is_true]),
    type_1_error = mean(significant[!is_true]),
    type_2_error = 1 - mean(significant[is_true]),
    coverage_true = mean(covered_unconditional[is_true], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_bias_true = mean(bias_unconditional[is_true], na.rm = TRUE),
    rmse_true = sqrt(mean(sq_error_unconditional[is_true], na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    iteration_level_summary %>%
      group_by(method, method_label, N, Rho, scenario_label) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_model_size = mean(model_size),
        any_false_positive_rate = mean(any_false_positive),
        perfect_model_recovery_rate = mean(perfect_model_recovery),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("method", "method_label", "N", "Rho", "scenario_label")
  ) %>%
  arrange(N, Rho, method)

table1_gt <- table1_data %>%
  select(
    scenario_label,
    Method = method_label,
    mean_model_size,
    tpr, fpr,
    mean_bias_true, rmse_true, coverage_true,
    type_1_error, type_2_error,
    any_false_positive_rate,
    perfect_model_recovery_rate
  ) %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "scenario_label") %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Table 1. Method Performance by Simulation Scenario**")
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Method = "Method",
    mean_model_size = "Mean Model Size",
    tpr = "TPR",
    fpr = "FPR",
    mean_bias_true = "Mean Bias",
    rmse_true = "RMSE",
    coverage_true = "Coverage",
    type_1_error = "Type I Error",
    type_2_error = "Type II Error",
    any_false_positive_rate = "Any FP",
    perfect_model_recovery_rate = "Perfect Recovery"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(mean_bias_true, rmse_true),
    decimals = 3
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = mean_model_size,
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  fmt_percent(
    columns = c(
      tpr, fpr, coverage_true,
      type_1_error, type_2_error,
      any_false_positive_rate, perfect_model_recovery_rate
    ),
    decimals = 1
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Selection",
    columns = c(mean_model_size, tpr, fpr)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Estimation (Unconditional)",
    columns = c(mean_bias_true, rmse_true, coverage_true)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Post-Selection Inference",
    columns = c(type_1_error, type_2_error)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Model Recovery",
    columns = c(any_false_positive_rate, perfect_model_recovery_rate)
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(10),
    data_row.padding = px(2)
  )

table1_gt
```

```{r}
#TABLE 2: True variable bias and coverage in independent and highest-correlation scenarios

table2_data <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(
    is_true,
    (N == 500 & Rho == 0) |
      (N == 250 & Rho == 0.70)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    scenario_group = case_when(
      N == 500 & Rho == 0 ~ "Independent, larger-sample scenario: N = 500, rho = 0",
      N == 250 & Rho == 0.70 ~ "Highest-correlation, smaller-sample scenario: N = 250, rho = 0.70"
    ),
    scenario_group = factor(
      scenario_group,
      levels = c(
        "Independent, larger-sample scenario: N = 500, rho = 0",
        "Highest-correlation, smaller-sample scenario: N = 250, rho = 0.70"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(scenario_group, method, method_label, var, true_beta) %>%
  summarise(
    selection_rate = mean(selected),
    mean_beta_hat  = mean(estimate_unconditional, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_bias      = mean(bias_unconditional, na.rm = TRUE),
    rmse           = sqrt(mean(sq_error_unconditional, na.rm = TRUE)),
    coverage       = mean(covered_unconditional, na.rm = TRUE),
    power          = mean(significant),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(scenario_group, method, true_beta)

table2_gt <- table2_data %>%
  select(
    Scenario = scenario_group,
    Method   = method_label,
    Variable = var,
    `True beta` = true_beta,
    selection_rate,
    mean_beta_hat,
    mean_bias,
    rmse,
    coverage,
    power
  ) %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "Scenario") %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Table 2. Per-Variable Bias and Coverage for True Predictors**"),
    subtitle = "Comparison of the independent, larger-sample scenario and the highest-correlation, smaller-sample scenario"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Method          = "Method",
    Variable        = "Variable",
    selection_rate  = "Selection Rate",
    mean_beta_hat   = "Mean Beta-Hat",
    mean_bias       = "Mean Bias",
    rmse            = "RMSE",
    coverage        = "Coverage",
    power           = "Power"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns  = c(`True beta`, mean_beta_hat, mean_bias, rmse),
    decimals = 3
  ) %>%
  fmt_percent(
    columns  = c(selection_rate, coverage, power),
    decimals = 1
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Estimation",
    columns = c(`True beta`, mean_beta_hat, mean_bias, rmse)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Selection and Inference",
    columns = c(selection_rate, coverage, power)
  ) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote  = "Estimates and bias are unconditional: unselected variables contribute beta-hat = 0 and bias = -true beta.",
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = c(mean_beta_hat, mean_bias))
  ) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote  = "Coverage counts an unselected true predictor as not covered.",
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = coverage)
  ) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote  = "Power is the proportion of simulations in which the true predictor was selected and significant after refitting.",
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = power)
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size  = px(9),
    data_row.padding = px(2)
  )

table2_gt
```

```{r}
table3_data <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(is_true) %>%
  group_by(method, method_label, var, true_beta) %>%
  summarise(
    selection_rate = mean(selected),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    var_label = paste0(var, " (β = ", sprintf("%.3f", true_beta), ")")
  )

table3_wide <- table3_data %>%
  select(method, method_label, var_label, selection_rate) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = var_label,
    values_from = selection_rate
  ) %>%
  arrange(method)

table3_gt <- table3_wide %>%
  select(-method) %>%
  rename(Method = method_label) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Table 3. True-Predictor Selection Rate by Effect Size**")
  ) %>%
  cols_label(Method = "Method") %>%
  fmt_percent(columns = -Method, decimals = 1) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(11),
    data_row.padding = px(3)
  )

table3_gt
```

```{r}
figure1_data <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(method, method_label, N, Rho, variable_type) %>%
  summarise(
    selection_rate = mean(selected),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metric = factor(
      if_else(
        variable_type == "True predictor",
        "True positive selection rate",
        "False positive selection rate"
      ),
      levels = c(
        "False positive selection rate",
        "True positive selection rate"
      )
    )
  )

N_labeller <- function(x) paste0("N = ", x)
metric_labeller <- function(x) x
rho_labeller <- function(x) paste0("rho = ", x)

fig1 <- ggplot(
  figure1_data,
  aes(
    x = Rho,
    y = selection_rate,
    group = method_label,
    color = method_label
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  facet_grid(
    metric ~ N,
    scales = "free_y",
    labeller = labeller(N = N_labeller, metric = metric_labeller)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = rho_values) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 1. True-Positive and False-Positive Selection Tradeoff",
    x = "Predictor correlation (rho)",
    y = "Selection rate",
    color = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

fig1
```

```{r}
#Figure 2: Mean selected model composition

figure2_data <- iteration_level_summary %>%
  select(method, method_label, N, Rho, true_positives, false_positives) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(true_positives, false_positives),
    names_to  = "component",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    component = recode(
      component,
      "true_positives"  = "True predictors selected",
      "false_positives" = "Null predictors selected"
    ),
    component = factor(
      component,
      levels = c("Null predictors selected", "True predictors selected")
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(method, method_label, N, Rho, component) %>%
  summarise(mean_count = mean(count), .groups = "drop")

rho_labeller <- function(x) paste0("rho = ", x)

annot_df <- tibble(
  N         = max(n_values),
  Rho       = max(rho_values),
  x_pos     = 1,
  y_pos     = 5.6,
  lbl       = "Dashed line: maximum possible true positives (5)"
)

fig2 <- ggplot(
  figure2_data,
  aes(x = method_label, y = mean_count, fill = component)
) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 5, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(
    data    = annot_df,
    aes(x = x_pos, y = y_pos, label = lbl),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust   = 0,
    size    = 2.6,
    color   = "grey20"
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    N ~ Rho,
    labeller = labeller(N = N_labeller, Rho = rho_labeller)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Null predictors selected" = "#E07A5F",
    "True predictors selected" = "#3DAEA3"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 2. Mean Selected Model Composition",
    x     = "Method",
    y     = "Mean number of predictors selected",
    fill  = "Predictor type"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position   = "bottom",
    axis.text.x       = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    strip.background  = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

fig2
```

```{r}
figure3_data <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(is_true) %>%
  group_by(method, method_label, N, Rho, var, true_beta) %>%
  summarise(
    selection_rate = mean(selected),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    var_label = factor(
      paste0(var, "\nβ=", sprintf("%.3f", true_beta)),
      levels = paste0(
        v_names[1:5],
        "\nβ=",
        sprintf("%.3f", beta_true[1:5])
      )
    )
  )

fig3 <- ggplot(
  figure3_data,
  aes(
    x = var_label,
    y = selection_rate,
    group = method_label,
    color = method_label
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 1.6) +
  facet_grid(
    N ~ Rho,
    labeller = labeller(N = N_labeller, Rho = rho_labeller)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 3. True-Predictor Selection Rate by Effect Size",
    subtitle = "By sample size and predictor correlation",
    x = "True predictor",
    y = "Selection rate",
    color = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8)
  )
```
